name: mobile-frontend
description: Composite skill for quality mobile-first frontend: codified rules (spacing 4/8-grid, clamp type scale, anchors under fixed headers, safe-area insets, tap-targets >=44px, design tokens) through build to a multi-level verification with per-element debugging - including menu/hamburger and navigation (open/close, aria-expanded sync, focus trap, Esc, anchor scroll, z-index). Routes aesthetics/contrast/Lighthouse/visual-QA to frontend-design-taste, frontend-perfection, /visual-qa. Triggers: 'mobile frontend', 'mobile-first', 'адаптив', 'мобильная вёрстка', 'mobile QA', 'проверь мобилку', 'меню не работает на телефоне', 'якоря упираются в шапку', 'mobile lighthouse'.
author: bestdeejay-design
